cases.name: root_creation_atomic

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: No world or creation result exists for requestId; initial school template is valid.

cases.expected: root/world/lease/claim/gate all roll back

cases.name: root_response_lost

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: The root creation transaction committed; its first HTTP response was lost.

cases.expected: same requestId returns the same world; claim tokens are never replayed

cases.name: root_ready_guard

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: The current head is a root with pending narration, generation 1 and a live head claim.

cases.expected: pending root rejects; no advance/round is committed

cases.name: successful_replay_first

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: The exact commit request already succeeded; head, revision and lease have since advanced; input text was cleared.

cases.expected: successful requestId replays original data with fresh control and no inputText

cases.name: request_reuse_conflict

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A successful world submission exists with the same requestId and a different normalized payload or operation.

cases.expected: different operation or normalized content rejects request_id_reused

cases.name: request_in_progress

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A first transaction owns the same world/requestId and has not committed.

cases.expected: request_in_progress retains original requestId

cases.name: lease_clock_and_fence

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: An open/staged PointWork is active; the supplied lease is expired or belongs to the previous epoch.

cases.expected: expired/old epoch lease rejects; no write or failure cleanup

cases.name: gate_cleanup_no_revision

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: The request bindings and lease are valid; the pending head claim is expired; revision is recorded before resolve_gate.

cases.expected: legal stale gate cleanup commits; business advancement rejected; revision unchanged

cases.name: binding_error_keeps_gate

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A pending gate exists; expectedCheckpointRevision or lease token is invalid.

cases.expected: invalid binding/lease does not clear gate

cases.name: pause_while_pending

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A live narration gate is pending and paused=false; record its issued/expiry timestamps.

cases.expected: pause persists without extending claim TTL; repeat changes no revision

cases.name: resume_expired_claim

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: paused=true; the head narration claim is expired and has not become ready.

cases.expected: paused=false persists; blockedReasons reports expired claim and canCompute=false

cases.name: ready_does_not_resume

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: paused=true; matching current generation/token/epoch narration is ready to submit.

cases.expected: cache/ready/gate clear atomically; paused/phase/revision preserved

cases.name: freeze_action_before_targets

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A source action is accepted by discover_group; target analysis has not completed.

cases.expected: accepted action retained byte-for-byte; target analysis not restarted from a new action

cases.name: roll_before_expansion

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A complete target set is accepted; a final roll row exists; admitted member expansion has not been saved.

cases.expected: same judgment row/eligibility/admission reused; no NULL intermediate or re-roll

cases.name: stage_before_next_actor

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A staged A unit and full candidates exist at cursor 1; B has not been analyzed; committed cursor remains 0.

cases.expected: saved A and candidates retained; B reads replayed working prefix; committed cursor unchanged

cases.name: stage_response_lost

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: The first stage_unit committed and its response was lost; preserve the exact requestId and candidates.

cases.expected: same requestId never appends a second unit

cases.name: consume_only_point_groups

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: P1 consumes A/B; a sealed successor reservation holds unconsumed C/D accepted work.

cases.expected: state/progress/group consumption/cleanup roll back together; C/D preserved

cases.name: current_epoch_max

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: Lease epoch is 8; member attempts are old epoch7/attempt99 and current epoch8/attempt1,2; all are accepted.

cases.expected: filter current epoch before max accepted attempt; validate TTL in service clock

cases.name: restore_original_bytes

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A new holder has epoch8; a still-active source manifest references epoch7 accepted immutable UTF-8 action/results/candidates.

cases.expected: raw bytes/results/candidates and copy identity commit together; failure rolls back

cases.name: restore_bad_source

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: The supplied manifest is unaccepted, belongs to another point/group, or references consumed/abandoned PointWork.

cases.expected: unconfirmed/cross-scope/consumed/abandoned source rejects without resampling

cases.name: restore_missing_or_corrupt

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: An active authoritative accepted-source reference exists; one referenced payload row is missing or its bytes fail the stored hash.

cases.expected: frozen_work_missing/corrupt blocks; active reference prevents GC

cases.name: restore_attempt_allocation

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: Several confirmed attempts exist across epochs; new holder supplies a valid source manifest without a destination attempt.

cases.expected: service allocates monotonically across epochs; request cannot choose attempt

cases.name: restore_business_dedup

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: Two different requestIds concurrently restore the identical source manifest into the same destination epoch.

cases.expected: same source manifest and target epoch reuses copy identity/attempt; no second allocation

cases.name: time_lock

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A begin_point time/baseline is persisted and at least one action/target/skip/scan dependency has been confirmed.

cases.expected: time and baseline cannot change after action/target/skip/scan/roll confirmation

cases.name: successor_prefix

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: P1 is sealed and a P2 reservation exists; mutate one predecessor identity/version/state/prefix/time binding.

cases.expected: all predecessor IDs/version/state/prefix/time bindings match or whole business commit rejects

cases.name: cancel_terminal

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: An advance has active current and reserved work plus frozen ID/roll records; input text is still present.

cases.expected: work abandoned, identity/roll tombstones retained, input cleared atomically; replay cannot revive

cases.name: conclusion_atomic

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A ready head has phase assess_continuation; a model continue or handback decision is uncommitted.

cases.expected: continue creates exactly one automatic successor; handback clears input; no fake point

cases.name: claim_renew_takeover

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A long model task holds a live claim; renew it, then let a new lease epoch acquire and reclaim.

cases.expected: renew preserves token/generation; new epoch can re-claim, old epoch late submit rejects

cases.name: cache_missing_old_generation

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A ready current-head narration cache was deleted at a stable boundary; an old generation submit arrives after a new claim.

cases.expected: only new valid generation can mark ready; world state/time not re-applied

cases.name: pure_time_full_scan

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: The round has zero acting members; the clock crosses task_wait_noon and triggers personality/sanity updates.

cases.expected: complete task/personality/sanity scan retained even without actors; input consumption preserved

cases.name: preview_budget

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: A valid preview is available; individually exceed request bytes, unit count, compute deadline and response bytes.

cases.expected: 512KiB/32 units/2s/2MiB reject without partial mutation; request/response limit details

cases.name: reference_retention_gc

preState.source: handwritten contract trace and active world/work references
arrange: An active current or sealed successor PointWork still references accepted old-epoch source rows; another group may already be consumed.

cases.expected: referenced old source rows remain until consumption or explicit abandonment

responsibility.gateResolution: A2/A3 transaction; never a blanket SQL control trigger
responsibility.visibleWork: SQL epoch-first view + A3 TTL/active-reference validation
responsibility.copyAndHash: A3 service verifies source/bytes then atomically inserts immutable rows
responsibility.commitOrder: A3 transaction; static FK constraints alone do not prove atomic behavior
